name: s7-ghaele
description: Sprint 7 T1 / REP-04 (reviews R1-F2, R2-F4, R3-F1, R3-F5, R3-F6): harness-observed Ghaele (kmgGhaeleLifetime) on whichever product package the session loads - the released v0.0.195 package (baseline) and the candidate - in the disposable fixture save (Jamandi mansion throne room, interior). Step lifecycle: the cast ownership boundaries (borrowed ability with non-default parameters, replaced temporary grant, abandonment with the command pending, abandonment after spawn before registration, an unrelated unit's command preserved). Step timeline: the published summon cast as one owned native command (caster level 20 for that cast only; the loan ends when the cast settles), arrival and appearance kept, native donor AzataGhaelSummoned spawned without a summon, an ordinary move, an ordinary combat against a disposable hostile target (a DefaultPlayerCharacter copy under a loaded faction hostile to the Ghaele, brain off) with attack rolls, the lighting context idle and in combat (ambient, light probe, nearby lights, the game camera party view through the product capture helper), time unpaused through the native expiry, and positive-only attribution of the body value to the donor loop. The product runs alone with the harness. Round 5: the cast's summon is the unit its own execution summoned (native RuleSummonUnit context); lifecycle adds a borrowed CL20 override, an injected incorrect restoration, a vanished borrowed ability and a foreign same-caster Ghaele from another execution in both abandonment cases; combat teardown releases only the probe's attacks, its target and the combat state it introduced, with an independent command on the main character; lighting rows are judged on their readbacks.
